subject: Coordination: Cardinal Health — cross-region onboarding plan and split sessions
messages:
From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@cardinalhealth.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence — two sessions?

Hi Connor,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found the console walkthrough helpful. We want to move to an enablement that covers both the Console (overview + RBAC/keys) and API integration (SDK, samples, rate guidance). Our org spans US East and West and a lot of engineers can't meet in the same 3-hour block.

Proposal: two focused 90-minute sessions — (1) Console + access prep for our platform/security folks, (2) API + integration for backend/data engineers. Prefer split across two days so we can have smaller, practical labs. Target week of Sep 27.

Attendees: Myself, Tom Becker (IT lead), plus 4 engineers (TBD).

I've attached our internal onboarding checklist — please advise what you need from your side (access, preflight items, and whether Redwood can cover recording and a short follow-up office hours).

Thanks,
Amy

[Attachment: cardinal_preflight_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 35KB)]

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: Amy Liu <amy.liu@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence — two sessions?

Hi Amy —

Appreciate the clear ask. Two 90-min sessions across two days works well and matches what we’ve had success with for multi-region teams. Attached is a lightweight agenda and the preflight items Redwood will own.

High-level proposal:
- Day 1 (Console): 90 minutes — Admin access, RBAC, keys, Console runthrough, quick troubleshooting playbook. Ideal for your IT/security + platform folks.
- Day 2 (API): 90 minutes — SDK examples, best-practice batching, streaming, and a short live lab where engineers push a simple inference call.

We can offer recordings and a 60-minute office-hours session 48 hours after Day 2 to handle deeper integration questions.

Proposed slots (Eastern times; we’ll create invites in both timezones):
- Option A: Tue Sep 28 10:00–11:30 ET (Console) / Wed Sep 29 10:00–11:30 ET (API)
- Option B: Wed Sep 29 14:00–15:30 ET (Console) / Thu Sep 30 14:00–15:30 ET (API)

Who from Redwood will join: Camila Reyes (session lead, Console), Tessa Morgan (API lead), plus one engineer/buffer (Ben Carter) for lab support.

Could you share the attendee list and confirm whether the engineers need pre-provisioned API keys or sandbox data? I’ll wait for one preferred option and then lock the invites.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

[Attachment: enablement_agenda_v3.pdf (PDF, 220KB)]

From: camila_reyes@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 12:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Onboarding cadence — two sessions?

Connor — quick internal note.

Thanks for drafting the slots. I'm on board for leading Console Day but Sep 28 morning conflicts with a Dedicated capacity incident review at 10am — I can swap if Ben covers the incident. Ben, can you cover incident review on Sep 28 if I run the 10am slot? Otherwise, prefer Option B afternoon block.

Also recommend we mark the Day 2 lab as "bring your own repo" to avoid env churn; ask Cardinal to provide a simple sample service or allow our sandbox to host the sample.

Camila
Lead Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Amy Liu <amy.liu@cardinalhealth.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding cadence — two sessions?

Connor, Camila —

Thanks for the options. We prefer Option B (Sep 29/30 at 14:00 ET) because several of our West Coast engineers finish earlier in the day. Tom confirmed he and two of our security folks will attend Day 1; our engineering roster for Day 2 will be Amanda Park (backend), Rafael Gomez (data infra), and two contractors (names to follow).

For preflight: please send the API key provisioning template. We also want the session recorded and a short (30-min) SSO/SCIM follow-up separate — Tom is requesting a quick SSO checklist before Day 1.

Tom Becker (cc) is our procurement lead — he’ll need the final attendee list and any SOX/SOC2 evidence for the training as part of internal tracking.

Amy

[Attachment: none]

Amy / Tom —

Great — Option B is locked. I’ve created calendar invites and included a short preflight checklist and API key provisioning template (Drive links below). Invitations include joins for both US/Eastern and US/Pacific. Calendar invites will show up from me (Connor O'Brien).
